rationale: C05 plausibly supplied a material drafting template. Issued only eleven days earlier, it uses the same distinctive sequence: identification of Hawaiian ceded public lands under the July 7, 1898 annexation resolution; land set aside by a Governor of Hawaii executive order; a finding that the land is no longer needed; and restoration to the Territory's “possession, use, and control.” C02 and C08 are strong members of the same drafting family, but their operative terminology restores land to the Territory's “jurisdiction,” making them less exact than C05.
